notes.title: Create your own levels
notes.content:
Updates added

Create function
- Place win zone, place elements x 6, place ledges x6 and place ground x 6
- Erase placements
- Preview level build
- Save created level for future replay
- Reset level placement and start again
- Decide what bricks will fall on the level

Load function
- Load created level
- Play through created level as playlist (repeat, previous, next or random)

Key art
- Key art updated
